Throughput at this seat, a SEPARATE object and never added to the above: **376,376 tape cl100k over 288 records** (user 67,722 · attachment 225,954 · assistant 81,780 · atis-latch 920).

> **wrap-handover: brief-cut 207,989 real (conductor, DECLARED in the #279 wrap brief as the check-in reading at 41 turns) · sub-cut 213,222 real (first-hand, `_checkin.py` at this seat on the SAME transcript, 43 turns / 41 continuous) · delta 5,233 real · replay unobservable (conductor-side, post-wrap)**

> **⚠ THE `delta` ABOVE IS A LEGAL SUBTRACTION AND THE NAMED WINDOW IS WHY.** The `s214-D5` clause homed here at #272 makes `delta` meaningful ONLY when both terms read the same window; `brief-cut` is the conductor's declared FILL and `sub-cut` is this seat's `_checkin.py` reading of **that same jsonl** — the transcript whose first user record is his opener — so the two numbers describe one thing and the subtraction stands. ⛔ **NO `subs` LINE IS WRITTEN FOR THIS SESSION.** The day's record names **13 lane labels** and **12 filed sub-reports**, the conductor's brief says *"eleven lanes"*, and the only sub-token figure anywhere is an ESTIMATE (*"≈2.4M"*). `s214-D5` makes ABSENT legal and makes absence never-defaulted: an estimate is not a measurement, so there is no line rather than a wrong one [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]]. ⚠ Both lane counts are published and neither is reconciled into the other — IL2 landed IV's fixes and filed IV's verify rather than a report of its own, which is the whole of the difference.

> **⚠ DECLARED SKIPS AND NOT-DONE AT THIS WRAP, EACH NAMED WITH ITS SIZE** (declare-last, and the size is the point): **2c, 2d and 2f ALL RAN** — the #277 ★ PRIOR banner (**12 lines**) rolled to `_GM-ARCHIVE.md` § Batch 2026-09-16 #279, the #276 ⏱ PRIOR DELTA (**28 lines**) rolled to `_LIVE-STATE-ARCHIVE.md` § Rolled 2026-09-16 #279 with #275's `Previous:` chain segment (**5,976 chars**) beside it, and `roll_2f #278` split **22 lines** into `notes/_GAUGE-LOG.md` at true EOF and **2 lines** into `_GM-ARCHIVE.md`; every move went through `knowledge/_gm_move.py` from session-owned, uniquely-named ops files asserted in the writing process before the mover read them (`notes/_lanes/279/W/ops-279-rolls-1789581989.json` **1,214 B / 5 ops**, `ops-279-lsdelta-1789582081.json` **13,439 B / 2 ops**, `ops-279-banner-1789582217.json` **3,905 B / 2 ops**, `ops-279-stratum-*.json`), dry-run first and every receipt read back against the ops meant to be run. **2e is a NO-OP — 0 lines**: DO-FIRST minted no notice, no tombstone and no lifecycle tag, and nothing was retro-tagged, so the `size:` stamp measures a DO-FIRST that did not move. **2c's EXIT CHECK found NOTHING needing homing by addition** — every ⚠/⬛/AWAITING item on the rolling #277 banner, the #276 delta and the #278 stratum already stands in `_CARRIES.md` § `residual → #280` or in `knowledge/_parked.json` (checked one by one; `P-273-1` lives in the parked register, which is a standing home, and the `#243 form` question is carried three times over). ⛔ **NOT REPAIRED HERE, EACH ONE INHERITED AND EACH ONE DAVE'S OR ANOTHER SESSION'S:** showroom **108 pages stale** (standing since #273, HIS call, passed to the commit script as `SHOWROOM_ACK`) · `_validate_roles_resolve.py` **FAIL(6)**, all six `data-grid` `with`-slugs · `_validate_lane_ownership.py --selftest` **2/3** · the boot-drift ceiling breach and the five boot double-counts of #243, #264, #272, #273 and #274, every one another session's append-only testimony in this very file. ✅ **ONE INHERITED STORE RED WAS REPAIRED BY THIS RITUAL:** `knowledge/_state.json`'s `W-278wr` row was missing its required `links` field — four #279 lane reports named it and none could fix it from a lane seat — and the field was added **by textual span with the reconstruction asserted before the write**, which is what an insertions-only `git diff --numstat` means. ⛔ **MEMORY (step 3) WAS NOT WRITTEN — A STRUCTURAL SEAT LIMIT, NOT A SKIP**: only the conductor's seat reaches the cloud Project store, so the hook is filed at `notes/_lanes/279/WRAP-MEMORY-HOOK.md` in the `s271-D4` shape for the conductor to place at the #280 opener.

> **⚠ `s214-D6` BANNER-DISCIPLINE MEASUREMENT — QUOTED FROM `_CHAIN.md`'s GENERATED FOOTER, NEVER RE-DERIVED, AND READ AFTER THE DECLARE-LAST `size:` STAMP because the stamp is itself inside the chain slice (the #240 lesson, homed in the runbook at #241).** The readings of this one ritual, in order, every one published and only the LAST one the number the next session pays: {CHAINSEQ}. ★ **The ★ LATEST banner itself measures {BANNERTK} tape over {BANNERLINES} substantive lines against the `s241-D2` cap of 1,200 / 10** — written tight by the `s214-D6` clause, which commands SHORTER and never decide-what-to-drop: not one item, carry, declared skip or receipt name was omitted to reach it, and the roll to `_GM-ARCHIVE.md` preserves #278's banner verbatim, so nothing is lost by writing this one lean.

> **COMMIT STATE #279:** ⬛ **THE HASH IS A DECLARED GAP IN THIS BLOCK, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE — A COMMIT CANNOT NAME ITSELF.** This wrap's commit sha is delivered in the returned report and is readable from `git log`. ⛔ **THE TREE WAS NOT IN SYNC WHEN THIS RITUAL OPENED, AND THAT IS THE DIFFERENCE FROM #278** — `git rev-list --count origin/master..HEAD` read **17** at this seat against `origin/master` = `7c72cc1` (#278's own lane-report commit): the #279 opener `c9af467` and all sixteen lane commits stood unpushed, which is a day of enactment work sitting local. ★ **This wrap PUSHES under `s207-D1`** (push is at the conductor's judgment; the ruled call form is `bash knowledge/_git_commit.sh --push`, master · ff-only · VERIFIED) and the push verdict is read back from the script's own literal `✅ pushed and VERIFIED` line — anything else is NOT a push, and the returned report quotes whatever came back verbatim. ⛔ **AND THE COMMIT PATH IS DECLARED, NOT QUIET:** the wrap gate is red on refusals that are ALL another session's append-only testimony in `notes/_GAUGE-LOG.md`, so this wrap committed on the script's `DECLARED not-a-wrap` path with `SESSION_N=279` — the `#243` form, the same path #243, #264 and #272…#278 took, and the reason the subject carries the `after #279 2026-09-16 — ` prefix. ⬛ **That a genuine wrap must declare itself not-a-wrap to get past refusals it is forbidden to repair is RULING-SHAPED and is Dave's; it is recorded here rather than smoothed, for the FIFTH wrap running.**
